🐾🎉 GIVEAWAY TIME! 🎉🐾

Calling all dog AND cat lovers! 🐶🐱💕

Philly Shih Tzus has teamed up with @forthefur and @maverick_mkg to give one lucky winner the For The Fur Happy Hour Collection!🍹🐾

Featuring three cocktail-inspired Daily Fur Mists — A-Paw-Rol Spritz, Paws Mop olitan, and Piña Pawlada — perfect for keeping your furry friends smelling fresh between baths!

HOW TO ENTER:

FOLLOW all three accounts:
@philly_shihtzus 
@forthefur 
@maverick_mkg 

❤️ LIKE this post!

🐶🐱 TAG a fellow dog or cat lover in the comments! Each tag counts as an additional entry!

📲 BONUS ENTRY: Share this post to your story and tag us!

📅 Winner will be announced November 10th!

And remember, you don't need to own a Shih Tzu to enter! All dog and cat lovers are welcome! 🐾❤️

GIVEAWAY DISCLAIMER: No purchase necessary to enter or win. Open to legal U.S. residents ages 18 and older. Void where prohibited by law. One winner will be randomly selected from eligible entries and announced on November 10, 2026. The winner will be contacted via direct message and must respond within 48 hours or an alternate winner may be selected. This giveaway is not sponsored, endorsed, administered by, or associated with Instagram or Meta. By entering, participants release Instagram from any responsibility related to this giveaway. Beware of fake accounts — we will never ask for payment or credit card information to claim your prize.
